observation.visible_scene: A backlit silhouette of a man in a jacket and trousers, viewed from behind, in a dark, fog-filled space. A bright diffuse light glows to the right of him and a beam falls from above; a faint reflection of his feet appears on the floor. He is mid-stride throughout.
visible_changes: The man's legs cycle through a walking gait: one foot lifts and swings forward, then plants, alternating repeatedly across the frames.
His arms swing slightly in time with the steps.
His apparent size in the frame gradually shrinks (head edge moves lower, feet edge moves higher), consistent with him walking away from the viewpoint into the depth.
The overhead beam and the right-side glow shift slightly in position and intensity, and the haze density varies subtly.
The floor reflection beneath him becomes more discernible as the sequence progresses.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether the walk started before or continues after this excerpt.
What causes the beam/light changes (source movement vs. camera).
Camera position or lens changes outside the visible evidence.
uncertain_details: The shrinkage could be partly due to camera movement/zoom rather than only the man's translation; the two are not separable from these frames alone.
Exact trajectory and speed of the walking man.
Whether the light beam physically moves or only its apparent angle changes.
